description:
The Chief Minister Divyangjan Empowerment Scheme known as Sambal was launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh on December 3, 2019. 

This scheme aims to empower persons with disabilities in the state of Madhya Pradesh. 

The initiative is part of a broader effort to ensure inclusivity and equal opportunities for individuals with disabilities. 

The primary objective of the Sambal scheme is to provide financial assistance and support to persons with disabilities. 

The scheme specifically targets individuals with various disabilities including physical disabilities, visual impairments, hearing impairments, and intellectual disabilities. 

The government aims to enhance the quality of life for these individuals through various forms of assistance. 

The scheme has set measurable targets to provide assistance to at least 1.5 million individuals with disabilities in Madhya Pradesh. 

The financial assistance provided under the Sambal scheme includes a monthly pension of ₹600 for individuals with disabilities. 

This pension is aimed at providing a basic level of financial support to help cover daily living expenses. 

In addition to the pension, the scheme also includes provisions for providing assistive devices. 

These devices are essential for improving mobility and enhancing the quality of life for persons with disabilities. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crore for the implementation of the Sambal scheme in the financial year 2020-2021. 

This funding is intended to ensure that the scheme can effectively reach its target beneficiaries. 

Eligibility criteria for the Sambal scheme include being a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 

Applicants must have a disability certificate issued by a recognized authority. 

The scheme is open to individuals aged 18 years and above. 

There is no upper age limit for eligibility. 

Income criteria specify that applicants must have a family income of less than ₹2 lakh per annum. 

This income threshold is designed to ensure that the benefits reach those who are most in need. 

The application process for the Sambal scheme is straightforward. 

Interested individuals must fill out an application form available at local government offices or online. 

The required documents include a copy of the disability certificate, proof of residence, and income certificate. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the local authorities. 

The review process typically takes about 30 days. 

Successful applicants are then enrolled in the scheme and begin receiving benefits. 

The pension is disbursed on a monthly basis directly into the beneficiaries' bank accounts. 

The first disbursement is usually made within one month of approval. 

Subsequent payments are made on the first of every month. 

The implementing authority for the Sambal scheme is the Department of Social Justice and Disabled Welfare in Madhya Pradesh. 

This department is responsible for overseeing the implementation and monitoring of the scheme. 

Contact details for the department can be found on the official Madhya Pradesh government website. 

The Sambal scheme also includes awareness programs to educate the public about the rights and needs of persons with disabilities. 

These programs aim to reduce stigma and promote inclusivity in society. 

In addition to financial assistance, the scheme also focuses on skill development. 

Skill development programs are designed to enhance employability among persons with disabilities. 

The government collaborates with various NGOs and organizations to provide training and support. 

The Sambal scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries since its launch. 

Many individuals have reported improved quality of life due to the financial assistance provided. 

The scheme has also been praised for its focus on inclusivity and empowerment. 

In the first year of implementation, the scheme reached over 500,000 beneficiaries. 

The government aims to expand the reach of the scheme in the coming years. 

Monitoring and evaluation mechanisms are in place to assess the impact of the Sambal scheme. 

Regular reports are generated to track the progress and effectiveness of the scheme. 

The government is committed to making necessary adjustments based on feedback and evaluations. 

In conclusion, the Chief Minister Divyangjan Empowerment Scheme (Sambal) is a significant initiative by the Madhya Pradesh government. 

It aims to empower persons with disabilities through financial assistance and support services. 

With a focus on inclusivity and skill development, the scheme seeks to improve the quality of life for individuals with disabilities. 

The commitment of the government to this cause is evident in the budget allocation and the structured implementation process. 

Overall, the Sambal scheme represents a crucial step towards ensuring that persons with disabilities have access to the resources and support they need to thrive in society.
